continuation.scope: Prospective engineering screen; no significance or population guarantee; no alternative winner

costs.scope: Training includes optimizer setup, training and checkpoint write; evaluation includes actor/model evaluation and prediction write; fit adds receipt preparation/payload hashing. Whole run also pays shared authentication, cache load and initialization. RSS is process-lifetime high-water, not a sum of fit peaks. Inherited preprocessing/preflight are separate costs, not included or claimed free.
